title: Salesforce Learning Guide Inputs
description: Typed inputs for a source-grounded, role-aware Salesforce learning brief.

topic.description: One bounded Salesforce topic to research and teach.

learning_outcome.description: Observable capability the learner should have after the brief.

learner_role.description: Salesforce administrator, developer, architect, analyst, consultant, release manager, or other named role.

learner_level.description: Current experience level used to select terminology and depth.

depth.description: Requested breadth and detail for the brief.

time_budget_minutes.description: Approximate number of minutes available for the lesson and practice.

product_context.description: Optional cloud, product, release/API, edition/license, package, project, or org context.

source_boundary.description: Controls whether the guide may research outside supplied material.

supplied_sources.description: Optional attached files, URLs, or evidence identifiers the guide must use.

target_org_alias.description: Optional authenticated org alias for org-specific learning evidence.

practice_authority.description: Maximum authority allowed for the practice task.
